title: Readiness Estimator: Enhanced Weathering Farms
definition: Estimates Enhanced Weathering Farms readiness from component maturity.
description:

Honest scoring is the point: a farm hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Enhanced Weathering Farms Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Enhanced Weathering Farms operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Enhanced Weathering Farms installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 48586 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where basalt supply monitoring, farm logistics redundancy, or spreading equipment maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Enhanced Weathering Farms Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Enhanced Weathering Farms: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Enhanced Weathering Farms — farms spreading rock dust for carbon.

Phase 1 — Prove (basalt supply): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (farm logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (spreading equipment): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (yield effects): farm hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and farms-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
